message.content:
Looking at the strip, the entire film is rendered in flat, low‑contrast grayscale with no color tint and no bright high‑key scenes. That rules out the color titles (Boogeyman, Silent House, Nosferatu the Vampyre, House on Haunted Hill, Little Shop of Horrors, Apollo 18) and also the classic B&W films with strong daylight/white‑garment peaks (His Girl Friday, Night of the Living Dead, The Passion of Joan of Arc, which is full of pale over‑exposed faces). The consistently dim, foggy, desaturated gray palette matches the slow, moody black‑and‑white look of *Carnival of Souls*.

Answer: C
